isolation: Python clients run under a process-local getaddrinfo override that pins every hostname to loopback, with IP literals passed through untouched. aiohttp is pinned to its ThreadedResolver so it cannot escape through a c-ares resolver. curl runs with --resolve entries for every spelling of each hostname. Node and Chromium only fetch URLs whose parsed host is exactly localhost, 127.0.0.1 or ::1, and Chromium aborts every request that would leave the machine before a packet is sent. No external traffic.
